column3: (Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion: every script is our own)
(Server Leaks Information via X-Powered-By: poweredByHeader is off)
(Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set: src/proxy.ts sets it on every page)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag: the scan runs over http on localhost; production is https-only with HSTS)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: ignored by browsers over http; asserted in tests/e2e/portal.security.spec.ts)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens: forms post through server actions and JSON routes that check Origin, with SameSite=Lax cookies)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: words like 'debug' inside framework bundles)
